name: just
description: Just Domain is a domain registrar. This plugin proposes names for the business you are building, checks whether the matching domain names are available and what registering and renewing each one costs, and returns a link to register an available name on justdomain.ai. It also checks whether a domain you already own at another registrar could move to Just Domain. Read-only: no order is placed and no payment is taken in the chat; you sign in and pay on justdomain.ai in your browser. Connects only to the hosted Just Domain MCP server at mcp.justdomain.ai; no account or API key is needed to search, and the plugin sends no telemetry. Privacy: https://justdomain.ai/privacy
